__help__.api_key: Anthropic API key — agent and/or Claude eval judge (settings key api_key, env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
__help__.base_url: Anthropic API base URL (default https://api.anthropic.com); set for a custom/proxy Claude endpoint.
__help__.openai_api_key: OpenAI API key for GPT-5 agent/judge (settings key openai_api_key, env OPENAI_API_KEY).
__help__.openai_base_url: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for GPT-5 (default https://api.openai.com/v1, env OPENAI_BASE_URL).
__help__.model: Optional default agent model id (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5); usually overridden by llm.model on the CLI.
__help__.max_tokens: Optional default max output tokens per LLM call.
__help__.max_turns: Optional default max agent turns per run.
__help__.connection: Snowflake connections.toml profile name for the optional Cortex backend (default 'default').
__help__.brave_api_key: Live web search (any one of brave/serper/tavily; Brave is primary).
__help__.serper_api_key: Live web search via Google Serper (fallback / scraping).
__help__.tavily_api_key: Live web search via Tavily (last-resort fallback).
__help__.jina_api_key: Jina Reader web/PDF fetch (optional; web_fetch/pdf_read fall back to Serper -> requests without it).
__help__.cortex_account: Optional Snowflake Cortex web-search/corpus PAT account (e.g. myaccount); leave empty unless using Cortex.
__help__.fetch_cache_path: Path to the fetch/pdf SQLite cache; empty or 'off' disables it.
__help__.use_azure_openai: Set true to route the eval judge through Azure-hosted GPT-4.1 (azure.enabled=true eval.judge_model=gpt-4-1-dev).
__help__.AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY: Azure OpenAI API key for the GPT-4.1 eval judge.
__help__.AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT: Azure OpenAI endpoint URL for the GPT-4.1 eval judge.
__help__.OPENAI_API_VERSION: Azure OpenAI API version for the GPT-4.1 eval judge (e.g. 2025-04-01-preview).
__help__.Enable1MContextModel: Set true to opt into the 1M-context Claude window for supported models.
